Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning legislative review of gray wolf conservation and management.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to legislative review of gray wolf conservation andmanagement; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature must approve or reject thedepartment of fish and wildlife's recommended final environmentalimpact statement and the gray wolf conservation and management plan asa whole. Legislative action must be in the form of a joint memorial. (1) If the legislature rejects the department of fish andwildlife's recommended final environmental impact statement and thegray wolf conservation and management plan, the department mustreconvene the wolf working group and resubmit a new environmentalimpact statement and gray wolf conservation and management plan to thelegislature the following legislative session. (2) If the legislature approves the department of fish andwildlife's recommended final environmental impact statement and thegray wolf conservation and management plan, the department may send thefinal environmental impact statement and the gray wolf conservation and p. 1 HB 1109management plan to the Washington state fish and wildlife commissionfor final review and decision.
